description: Patch Integrity Ledger: sha256 of every file that intentionally diverges from pristine pi-agent-browser-native 0.6.13 (see PATCHES.md). Drift is a hard pre-spawn refusal — re-apply per PATCHES.md, no silent fallback. Re-pin hashes only from a verified tree after re-applying patches. There is no P4 (see PATCHES.md).

entries.upstreamDefect: Launch-scoped flags were only guarded for managed sessions and 11 flags went unrecognized (LAUNCH_SCOPED_FLAGS 26 → 37).

state clear <name> ignored the name and deleted every saved state file (P5); diff snapshot without --baseline diffed an empty baseline and always reported changed (P6); state rename cannot be delegated upstream inside batch (P8).
state rename <old> <new> failed in every documented form (sessionless forwarding → Missing 'path' parameter; path-like operand → Invalid session name).
set geo <lat> <lon> succeeded but never granted the geolocation permission, so pages always got User denied Geolocation (wrapper stub-install half).
set geo emulation stayed invisible to the caller without a result note carrying the --init-script + sessionMode recipe (note half of P9).
set geo never granted the geolocation permission; this new module installs the page-level navigator.geolocation stub (getCurrentPosition/watchPosition/clearWatch, permissions.query → granted).
Root sessions (pi-root-*) accepted mid-session launch-scoped flags that upstream silently ignores.

storage local get <missing-key> rendered a redacted [REDACTED] for a nonexistent value (P1); errors --clear reported success while the rows survived (P7); cookies get silently ignored --url so an empty list read as proof of no cookies (P10).
Batch snapshot --search/--filter steps were presented unfiltered, contradicting the same command run directly.
Batch snapshot --search/--filter steps presented unfiltered results; this new module applies the requested filter in presentation.

Providers stringify array/object tool params, so every args-mode call reported 'Provide exactly one input mode' (P28 prepareArguments); prompt-surface slimming (guide-gate companion, Round-2 lineage — current shape maintained in playbook.js, see PATCHES.md).

Wave-7 numeric-token coercion was unreachable: the Pi host validates the `stdin` tool param as an array-of-string-arrays before execute() runs, so [["mouse","move",489,119]] never reaches this file on this host. Dead code that misrepresented the contract was deleted; the error still names the offending token type.
No structural guard existed against local-patch clobbering: an update could overwrite the 28 hand-applied patches and the wrapper would keep spawning silently (pre-spawn verifyPatchLedger gate).

The click-dispatch probe counted EVERY trusted event that reached the target equally, so a bare pointerdown satisfied it. Any target that was re-rendered or moved between mousedown and mouseup therefore read as a successful dispatch, hiding the single most common real-browser false success: upstream reports 'Clicked: @eN', the app does nothing.
entries.localFix: The probe now separates press events (pointerdown/mousedown) from terminal ones (pointerup/mouseup/click) and only a terminal event clears a miss. Press-without-terminal is reported as the distinct status press-observed-click-missing and named as such in the summary, so the caller is told the element was re-rendered or moved instead of receiving the generic no-event wording. No synthetic click is ever dispatched.
